summary: Fort Technology Inc filed a Form 6-K reporting a board resignation and appointments. Tamir Fayerman resigned as director and Audit Committee Chairman for personal reasons, not due to any disagreement. Asaf Itzhaik was appointed as Chairman of the Audit Committee, and Ohad Melnik-Marom was appointed as a director. The changes are routine and not forced or abrupt. This filing does not qualify as a special situation, as it reflects ordinary governance updates with no material strategic impact. The event lacks the characteristics of a forced departure or activist-driven change.
